sampleEssays.title: A Lost Wallet
sampleEssays.content:
Last Sunday, I went to the city centre by bus with my family. We got off the bus, and it drove away.

Then I could not find my wallet. I looked in my bag and my pockets, but it was not there. I realised that I had left it on the bus. I was very worried.

I went to the Lost and Found office to ask for help. A kind lady was there. She had my wallet! Someone had found it on the bus. She gave it back to me.

I was very happy. I said, "Thank you very much!" After that, I always looked after my things carefully.

sampleEssays.title: A Lost Wallet
sampleEssays.content:
Last Sunday, I went to the city centre with my family. We waited at the bus stop and soon our bus arrived. We got on the bus and went to the city centre.

When we arrived, we got off the bus. The bus drove away, and I suddenly realised that my wallet was missing. I checked my school bag and my pockets, but I could not find it. I thought I had left it on the bus.

I was worried, so I went to the Lost and Found office and asked for help. Luckily, a kind person had found my wallet and handed it in. The staff member gave it back to me.

I was very happy and thanked her. That day, I learned to take good care of my belongings.

sampleEssays.title: A Lesson Learnt
sampleEssays.content:
Last Sunday was a sunny day, so my family and I decided to visit the city centre. We hopped on Bus 12, chatting excitedly about our plans for the day.

When the bus reached our stop, we got off in a hurry. As the bus pulled away, I reached into my pocket and my heart sank. My wallet was gone! I searched my school bag frantically, but it was nowhere to be found. I must have dropped it on the bus.

Without wasting a second, we rushed to the Lost and Found office and asked for help. To my relief, a friendly staff member held up a brown wallet. "Is this yours?" she asked with a smile. An honest passenger had handed it in!

I thanked her again and again. That day, I learned to keep my belongings safe and never to be careless again.

sampleEssays.title: A Missed Bus
sampleEssays.content:
Last Monday, I went to school with my friends. We waited for Bus 12 at the bus stop. We talked and laughed.

When the bus came, we were too slow. We missed the bus, and it drove away. I was worried because I did not want to be late for school.

We walked to school together. Near the school gate, I opened my school bag. My wallet was not there! I looked for it, but I could not find it.

I went to the Lost and Found office. A kind lady there had my wallet. Someone had found it and handed it in. I was very happy and said, "Thank you!" That day, I learned to be more careful.

sampleEssays.title: A Missed Bus
sampleEssays.content:
Last Monday, I went to school with my friends. We waited at the bus stop for Bus 12. We were excited because we did not want to be late for school. However, I was too slow and missed the bus. The bus drove away before I could get on it.

I felt worried because I did not want to be late for school. I decided to walk to school with my friends. On the way, I opened my school bag and realised that my wallet was missing. I looked for it everywhere, but I could not find it.

When I arrived at school, I went to the Lost and Found office. Luckily, a teacher had found my wallet and handed it in. I was very happy and thanked her.

That day, I learned to be more careful with my belongings.

sampleEssays.title: A Morning Full of Surprises
sampleEssays.content:
Last Monday morning, my friends and I were waiting at the bus stop for Bus 12. We were so busy chatting about a funny video that we hardly noticed the bus pulling up beside us.

By the time we looked up, the doors had closed and the bus was already driving away. "Oh no! We missed the bus!" I cried. My heart was pounding because I hated being late for school. Without wasting any time, we decided to walk there instead.

Just as we reached the school gate, I opened my school bag to take out my student card. To my horror, my wallet was nowhere to be found. I searched every pocket, but it had vanished.

Feeling anxious, I hurried to the Lost and Found office. To my relief, a smiling staff member held up my purple wallet. A teacher had found it near the bus stop and handed it in. I thanked her gratefully. That day, I learned to pay more attention and take better care of my belongings.
